Jordan Lee: quick thread to lock scope for the Optimize Toolkit slice we're calling 'Efficiency Advisor' 1 sprint box	. Need to decide final MVP: batching recs, cache TTL guidance, quant guidance (doc-only?), eval-triggered alerts. Thoughts?

Priya Shah: Vote: MVP = route-level batching suggestions + KV-prefix TTL recs + exportable JSON snippets + eval webhook (Slack alerts only). Quantization automation deferred; provide a short playbook instead. Keep UI minimal.

Carlos Mendes: Agree. Important: each recommendation needs a confidence score and a short rationale line (e.g., "high request similarity, low payload variance"). Recs should include expected cost delta and p95 impact.

Maya Liu: From SRE: telemetry window = 14 days sounds right. Also we must provide a simulator to estimate latency impact before surfacing recs. Canary plan: support applying recs to a traffic tag (2-5%).

Jordan Lee: Acceptance criteria draft: (1) recommender outputs ranked recs with confidence, cost %, and latency estimate; (2) JSON export + SDK snippet for Node/Python; (3) eval-alert webhook that posts regression events to Slack; (4) docs + two pilot customers onboarded.

Priya Shah: Timeline constraints: recommender POC (2 sprints), export+SDK (0.5 sprint), simulator + eval-hook (1 sprint). We should parallelize SDK and docs. If we need to cut scope, cut automated quant pipeline.

Carlos Mendes: Ranking formula proposal: score = 0.5*cost_savings_norm + 0.3*latency_benefit_norm + 0.2*quality_risk_inverse. We'll include a small dollar-estimate column using common cloud price profiles.

Maya Liu: Guardrails: if paired-eval shows >1% absolute quality drop or p95 increases >20% on canary, flag rec as 'requires manual review'. Also capture p99 in reports since batching affects tails.

Jordan Lee: UX notes: show a one-line "why" and an "Export config" button. Example snippet: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","batching":{"enabled":true,"target_latency_ms":220},"cache":{"prefix":"session:","ttl_seconds":45}}
```

Priya Shah: Ops: I'll coordinate pilot invites (HealthCo + NovaLabs) and two eval sets (chat + long-form). We'll run paired-evals on historical prompts before pilot.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPT-4510 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator, sdk-snippets, eval-webhook, pilot-onboarding. Link: https://tracker.internal/OPT-4510

Jordan Lee: Locked scope: suggest & export only, eval alerts to Slack, docs + 2 pilots. Auto-apply and quant automation deferred to next cycle. Thanks team :rocket:
